_comment: Merge the headers block into frontend/vercel.json (keep the existing rewrites).

The Content-Security-Policy is REPORT-ONLY: the browser lists what it would block in the console but blocks nothing. Open every page (sign in, upload, 3D view, admin) with the console open, fix what is reported, then rename the key to Content-Security-Policy to enforce it.
Project: tzmjtbemafzsdlstwmgg.supabase.co. Services: 13-54-125-85.nip.io. Change both if they change.

The sha256 allows the one inline script in frontend/index.html (the theme bootstrap). It is the hash of the script text with LF line endings, which is what Vercel builds from. If you edit that script, recompute it, or move the script into a file and drop the hash.
wss:// is needed for Supabase realtime (UserContext signs out accounts deleted while open). style-src needs 'unsafe-inline' for the UI libraries' injected styles.
frame-ancestors is ignored in report-only mode; X-Frame-Options covers it meanwhile.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-2aza2NGsRNygIChdVjbbU4KMb7cZZtgZp7mkchb+Stw='; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://tzmjtbemafzsdlstwmgg.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' https://tzmjtbemafzsdlstwmgg.supabase.co wss://tzmjtbemafzsdlstwmgg.supabase.co https://13-54-125-85.nip.io; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
